52754-profits-from-scrap.creator: Unknown
52754-profits-from-scrap.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Every battery that has to be opened must have the top connectors drilled off as in Fig. 1, which naturally makes a lot of lead chips. These drillings have to be cleaned off before proceeding with the repair and can, with no loss of time, all be collected, as in Fig. Then the old sulphated end connectors and parts from “junked” batteries accumulate very fast.

arxiv-2108-07765.title: Construction of Fractal Order and Phase Transition with Rydberg Atoms
arxiv-2108-07765.creator: Nayan E. Myerson-Jain, Stephen Yan, David Weld, Cenke Xu
arxiv-2108-07765.description: Abstract We propose the construction of a many-body phase of matter with fractal structure using arrays of Rydberg atoms. The degenerate low energy excited states of this phase form a self-similar fractal structure. This phase is analogous to the so-called “type-II fracton topological states”.

arxiv-2109-11828.title: A multiple criteria approach for bulding a pandemic impact assessment composite indicator: The case of Covid-19 in Portugal Journal: European Journal of Operational Research
arxiv-2109-11828.creator: José Rui Figueira, Henrique M. Oliveira, Ana Paula Serro, Rogério Colaço, Filipe Froes, Carlos Robalo Cordeiro, António Diniz, Miguel Guimarães
arxiv-2109-11828.description: Abstract The Covid-19 pandemic has caused major damage and disruption to social, economic, and health systems (among others). In addition, it has posed unprecedented challenges for public health and policy/decision makers who have been responsible for designing and implementing measures to mitigate its strong negative impact.

arxiv-2204-06259.title: Twin-in-the-loop state estimation for vehicle dynamics control: theory and experiments
arxiv-2204-06259.creator: Giorgio Riva, Simone Formentin, Matteo Corno, Sergio M. Savaresi
arxiv-2204-06259.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Giorgio Riva, Simone Formentin, Matteo Corno, Sergio M. Savaresi. In vehicle dynamics control, many variables of interest cannot be directly measured, as sensors might be costly, fragile or even not available. Therefore, real-time estimation techniques need to be used. The previous approach suffers from two main drawbacks: (i) the approximations due to model mismatch might jeopardize the performance of the final estimation-based control; (ii) each new estimator requires the calibration from scratch of a dedicated model.

arxiv-2212-14198.title: Load Balancer Tuning: Comparative Analysis of HAProxy Load Balancing Methods
arxiv-2212-14198.creator: Connor Rawls, Mohsen Amini Salehi
arxiv-2212-14198.description: Abstract Load balancing is prevalent in practical application (e.g., web) deployments seen today. One such load balancer, HAProxy, remains relevant as an open-source, easy-to-use system. In the context of web systems, the load balancer tier possesses significant influence over system performance and the incurred cost, which is decisive for cloud-based deployments.

arxiv-2302-00324.title: Galois Points and Cremona Transformations Thanks: The author acknowledges support from the Federal Commission for Scholarships for Foreign Students (FCS)
arxiv-2302-00324.creator: Ahmed Abouelsaad
arxiv-2302-00324.description: Abstract . In this article, we study Galois points of plane curves and the extension of the corresponding Galois group to Bir ⁡ ( ℙ 2 ) \mathrm{Bir}(\mathbb{P}^{2}) . If the Galois group has order at most 3 3 , we prove that it always extends to a subgroup of the Jonquières group associated to the point P P .

arxiv-2305-05287.title: Nanomechanical Photothermal Near Infrared Spectromicroscopy of Individual Nanorods
arxiv-2305-05287.creator: Kostas Kanellopulos, Robert G. West, Silvan Schmid
arxiv-2305-05287.description: Abstract Understanding light-matter interaction at the nanoscale requires probing the optical properties of matter at the individual nano-absorber level. To this end, we have developed a nanomechanical photothermal sensing platform that can be used as a full spectromicroscopy tool for single molecule and single particle analysis.

arxiv-2310-11907.title: Interlacing Properties of Eigenvalues of Laplacian and Net-Laplacian Matrix of Signed Graphs
arxiv-2310-11907.creator: Satyam Guragain, Ravi Srivastava
arxiv-2310-11907.description: Abstract This paper explores interlacing inequalities in the Laplacian spectrum of signed cycles and investigates interlacing relationship between the spectrum of the net-Laplacian of a signed graph and its subgraph formed by removing a vertex together with its incident edges.

arxiv-2501-18306.title: The theory of one-relator groups: history and recent progress
arxiv-2501-18306.creator: Marco Linton, Carl-Fredrik Nyberg-Brodda
arxiv-2501-18306.description: Abstract Preface The theory of one-relator groups is now almost a century old. The authors therefore feel that a comprehensive survey of this fascinating subject is in order, and this document is an attempt at precisely such a survey. This article is divided into two chapters, reflecting the two different phases in the story of one-relator groups.

arxiv-2508-05738.creator: Norman Hogan, Efekan Kökcü, Thomas Steckmann, Liam P. Doak, Carlos Mejuto-Zaera, Daan Camps, Roel Van Beeumen, Wibe A. de Jong, A. F. Kemper

Kemper. The accurate theoretical description of materials with strongly correlated electrons is a formidable challenge, at the forefront of condensed matter physics and computational chemistry alike, and it is one of the targets for quantum computing.

arxiv-2512-05854.title: A new Gaia census of OB associations within 1 kpc 2026 A new Gaia census of OB associations within 1 kpc – 6
arxiv-2512-05854.creator: Alexis L. Quintana, Nicholas J. Wright, Lilly A. Kormann, João Alves, David Katz, Laia Casamiquela, Paola Di Matteo, Misha Haywood, Chervin Laporte
arxiv-2512-05854.description: Abstract OB associations are primordial tracers of star formation and Galactic structure. Originally defined about 80 years ago, their historical membership lists have been superseded thanks to the precise astrometry from ESA’s Gaia ’s satellite. Recent studies have however been mostly focused on individual OB associations or limited by the coverage of spectroscopic surveys.

pmc-10560081.title: Speech-Language Therapy Through Telepractice During COVID-19 and Its Way Forward: A Scoping Review
pmc-10560081.creator: Ishita Guglani, Sanskriti Sanskriti, Shiv H Joshi, Ashish Anjankar
pmc-10560081.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The overall burden of voice disorders is vast, and speech-language therapy has been in use for long to prevent, assess, diagnose, and treat different speech and language disorders. Due to the COVID-19 outbreak, these services are not readily accessible because of various precautionary measures that have been laid down by the government to check the blowout of infection; as a solution to this, there has been a rise in telepractice.

pmc-10603007.title: Reliability of the DSS-Swe Questionnaire
pmc-10603007.creator: Anders Jans, Eva Rask, Johan Ottosson, Anders Magnuson, Eva Szabo, Erik Stenberg
pmc-10603007.description: BackgroundSymptomatic postbariatric hypoglycemia (PBH) is a known complication that can occur a few years after Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (RYGB). There is currently no established rating scale for PBH-associated symptoms developed for use in Swedish populations. The aim of the study was to translate an already existing questionnaire into Swedish and to test its reliability.

pmc-11334559.title: Complete and partial spontaneous regression of metastases of lung cancer in a patient: Serial CT and 18F-fluodeoxyglucose PET/CT findings
pmc-11334559.creator: Shota Tatsumoto, Yuji Ito, Tomohiko Yamane, Hideyuki Nishiofuku, Ryosuke Taiji, Takeshi Nagata, Haruka Ishiguro, Aya Yamada, Toshio Kato, Toshihiro Tanaka
pmc-11334559.description: Spontaneous regression of cancer is a rare biological phenomenon and the mechanisms underlying it are poorly understood. There have been few reports of temporal changes in morphology and metabolism associated with spontaneous regression. Here, we report an 80-year-old man who presented with right upper quadrant pain.

pmc-11375695.title: Effect of Low-Rank and High-Rank Coal Blend Characteristics on the Gasification Performance in Fixed Bed Reactor
pmc-11375695.creator: Sanjeev
pmc-11375695.description: Coal gasification is the most demanding technology, increasing day by day for synthesis gas and chemical production in a clean environment. Coal is a primary source of energy or fuel. India has a high preservation of high-ash coal. Employment of this coal for gasification is tough due to its abrasive nature.

pmc-11454228.title: 6849 Insulin Edema in newly diagnosed T1DM Pediatric Patient
pmc-11454228.creator: Aisha Ansar, Kyle McNerney
pmc-11454228.description: Disclosure: A. Ansar: None. K. McNerney: None. Background: Insulin edema is a rare complication of insulin therapy, especially in the pediatric populations. The pathogenesis is not fully understood but has been linked to Insulin’s role in renal sodium handling and vascular permeability.

pmc-12719904.title: Molecular Profiling of KRAS, NRAS, and BRAF in Colorectal Cancer: Insights From a Libyan Cohort
pmc-12719904.creator: Hoda M Tawel, Monira A Rahuma, Nada A Hweissa
pmc-12719904.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). IntroductionColorectal cancer (CRC) is a significant global health issue with a rising incidence, particularly high in Libya, posing serious public health concerns. This study aimed to determine the prevalence and clinicopathological associations of KRAS, NRAS, and BRAF mutations in a Libyan CRC cohort, as these mutations are key drivers of tumorigenesis and predictors of resistance to anti-epidermal growth factor receptor therapy.

pmc-13179880.title: Breaking glycolysis: allosteric hotspots for multi-target drug repurposing
pmc-13179880.creator: Latife Sude Vural, Elcin Kahraman, Simay Mintemur, Sinem Urhan, E Demet Akten
pmc-13179880.description: Glycolysis is essential for cellular energy production, making its enzymes attractive antimicrobial targets. Traditional strategies targeting conserved catalytic sites risk host toxicity due to limited species specificity. Allosteric sites—spatially distinct, evolutionarily divergent regulatory regions—offer selective inhibition but are challenging to detect experimentally.

pmc-13385265.title: Within-trial and across-trial distractor rejection mechanisms
pmc-13385265.creator: Luca Betteto, Matteo De Tommaso, Massimo Turatto
pmc-13385265.description: Color singleton distractors’ interference is known to be modulated by rejection mechanisms based on the distractors’ probability of occurrence at different locations. Here, to further address color-singleton distractor rejection, we used a modified version of the additional-singleton paradigm, where four consecutive displays were presented in rapid succession on each trial.
